title: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: stop sequences, logprobs, function-calls, and structured-output
author: Evan Rodriguez
description: Context: Customers expect parity with the OpenAI /v1/chat.completions surface for a range of parameters and behaviors. Motivation: enable drop-in compatibility for stop sequences, top-level 'logprobs' support for token-level scoring, clearer stop_reason handling in streaming mode, and better integration between function-calling/tooling and structured-output modes. This PR implements a compatibility layer and end-to-end tests to cover the most common breakage points. Changes: 1) API layer: expand openai_compat handler to accept and normalize 'stop' (string | list), 'logprobs' (int | null), and the official function_call hinting fields; 2) Streaming: ensure stop detection emits final 'stop_reason' metadata and drains KV cache correctly without truncating subsequent tokens; 3) Logprobs: wire token-level scoring through the response pipeline and include both 'token_logprobs' and 'top_logprobs' when requested; 4) Function/tool calling: preserve function_call hints in streaming chunks, and attach a deterministic 'invocation' object in the final message for structured consumers; 5) Structured-output: add a lightweight formatter that enforces top-level JSON when schema=structured is requested and emits an explicit 'parse_error' field instead of failing the stream; 6) Docs & examples: add compatibility docs and an example showing stop sequences with function calls and structured output. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged if OpenAI fields are not present. Migration notes: client should pass stop as list when multiple sequences are required; when requesting logprobs the response size will increase—advise batching limits in the client. Testing: added unit tests for normalization, integration tests that exercise streaming stop and function invocation boundary cases, and an e2e example against the openai-compat harness. Checklist: - [x] normalize 'stop' input formats - [x] implement token-level logprobs pipeline - [x] add streaming stop_reason metadata - [x] wire function_call hints into final structured invocation - [x] add compatibility docs and examples - [x] add integration + e2e tests Related: ENG-4281 (compat parity), ENG-4310 (streaming stop fixes).
commits: feat(openai-compat): normalize stop param (string or array) and unify internal representation
feat(streaming): emit stop_reason metadata at stream termination and ensure trailing buffers flushed
feat(logprobs): propagate token_logprobs and top_logprobs through response formatter
feat(functions): carry function_call hints through chunks and attach final invocation object
test: add integration test for stop+function-call interactions and structured output e2e
docs: add openai-compat/chat-completions.md with examples and migration notes
